text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan

(Barang-Barang Kawalan) 2020.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai

barang-barang kawalan bagi tempoh mulai 20 Januari 2020 hingga 2 Februari 2020.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

1. Kubis bulat import (Indonesia dan China, tidak termasuk kubis Beijing)

2. Ikan bawal putih (berat antara 200 gram hingga 400 gram seekor)

3. Udang putih besar (berat antara 41 ekor hingga 60 ekor sekilogram)

4. Babi hidup

5. Daging babi (perut)

6. Daging babi (daging dan lemak)

7. Tomato

8. Cili merah

Dibuat 15 Januari 2020

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/VIII]

DATUK SERI SAIFUDDIN NASUTION BIN ISMAIL

Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri

dan Hal Ehwal Pengguna

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) ORDER 2020

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the

Control of Supplies Act 1961 [Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

Order 2020.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles for

the period from 20 January 2020 to 2 February 2020.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

1. Imported round cabbage (Indonesia and China, not including Beijing

cabbage)

2. White pomfret (weight ranges between 200 grams to 400 grams each)

3. Large banana prawn (weight ranges between 41 prawns to 60 prawns

per kilogram)

4. Live pig

5. Pork (belly)

6. Pork (lean and fat)

7. Tomato

8. Red chili

Made 15 January 2020

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/VIII]

DATUK SERI SAIFUDDIN NASUTION BIN ISMAIL

Minister of Domestic Trade

and Consumer Affairs
